name: ThreadPanel
label: Thread panel
description: The session-history rail for chat products: brand header, new-thread action, standing controls, projects, grouped detail-rich threads, and a profile footer.

props.name: groups
props.description: The history, in display order. A flat list is one group with no label.

props.name: activeThreadId
props.description: Id of the thread on stage. Its row renders filled and carries `aria-current`.

props.name: onThreadSelect
props.description: Fires with the clicked thread's id. Rows with an `href` navigate as well.

props.name: threadActions
props.description: Shared menu actions for every thread row, behind a hover-revealed trailing trigger; a thread's own `actions` overrides the set. The menu renders only when `onThreadAction` is also given, and never on a `pending` row.

props.name: onThreadAction
props.description: Fires with the thread's id and the chosen action's id.

props.name: statusLabels
props.description: Spoken text for each thread status, read after the row's title; the dot itself is decorative. Merged over the English defaults (Working, Unread, Needs input, Failed). `idle` is silent unless given a label here.

props.name: pinnedLabel
props.description: Spoken text for a `pinned` thread, read after the title and any status; the pin glyph itself is decorative. Not read on a `pending` row, whose name is its tooltip alone.

props.name: threadMenuLabel
props.description:
Accessible name for a row's menu trigger. A string is followed by a colon
and the thread's title ("Thread options: Q3 plan"); a function is given
the title and returns the whole name, so a translation can put the title
where its grammar needs it.

props.name: renamingThreadId
props.description: Id of the thread being renamed: its row swaps to an inline text field, prefilled with the title and selected. The host owns the state, like everything else.

props.name: onThreadRename
props.description: Fires with the thread's id and the trimmed new title when a rename commits (Enter, or focus leaving the field). An empty or unchanged value fires `onRenameCancel` instead.

props.name: onRenameCancel
props.description: Fires when a rename ends without a change: Escape, an empty value, or an unchanged title.

props.name: renameLabel
props.description: Accessible name for the inline rename field.

props.name: logo
props.description: Brand mark slot at the top, e.g. a logo ``. While collapsed it doubles as the expand button, AppSidebar's contract.

props.name: logoText
props.description: Brand name beside the logo. The header row renders only when `logo`, `logoText`, or `onExpandedChange` is given.

props.name: newThreadLabel
props.description: Text for the new-thread row. Defaults to "New thread". The row renders when this, `onNewThread`, or `newThreadHref` is given.

props.name: newThreadIcon
props.description: Icon for the new-thread row — Material Symbol name (string) or custom element (ReactNode). Defaults to the pen-in-a-box `edit_square`, the same glyph chat headers use for New chat.

props.name: newThreadShortcut
props.description: Keyboard hint rendered as compact Kbds at the row's trailing edge, as literal keycaps, e.g. `["Ctrl", "N"]`. Decorative — the host owns the actual binding.

props.name: newThreadKeys
props.description: Keyboard hint at the row's trailing edge in the shortcut grammar (`mod+shift+o`), drawn in the reader's platform legends. Decorative — bind the action with `useShortcut`. Wins over `newThreadShortcut`.

props.name: keyLabels
props.description: Replaces any legend `newThreadKeys` is drawn with, such as `{ ctrl: 'Strg' }` for a German keyboard.

props.name: onNewThread
props.description: Fires when the new-thread row is clicked.

props.name: newThreadHref
props.description: Optional href — the new-thread row renders as an `<a>`.

props.name: controls
props.description: Standing rows between the new-thread action and the history, e.g. Automations or Settings.

props.name: onControlSelect
props.description: Fires with the clicked control's id. Rows with an `href` navigate as well.

props.name: projects
props.description: Project rows between the standing controls and the history, under their own group heading. The section renders only when non-empty; collapsed, the rows fold to icon circles like the controls.

props.name: projectsLabel
props.description: The projects section's group heading text.

props.name: activeProjectId
props.description: Id of the open project. Its row renders filled and carries `aria-current`.

props.name: onProjectSelect
props.description: Fires with the clicked project's id. Rows with an `href` navigate as well.

props.name: onProjectCreate
props.description: Fires when the header's trailing new-project button is pressed. The button renders only when this is given.

props.name: newProjectLabel
props.description: Accessible name for the new-project button.

props.name: moreLabel
props.description: Text for the quiet trailing row that reveals older threads, e.g. "Show 20 more". Renders only when given.

props.name: onShowMore
props.description: Fires when the more row is clicked.

props.name: historyLabel
props.description: Accessible name for the scrollable history region.

props.name: expanded
props.description: Whether the panel is expanded (280px, labels and history showing). Collapsed it is AppSidebar's 64px icon rail: circular icon rows, the history faded out, the avatar alone in the footer.

props.name: onExpandedChange
props.description: Fires with the next state when the toggle (or, collapsed, the logo) is pressed. The toggle renders only when this is given; the panel is controlled, so the host owns the state.

props.name: collapseLabel
props.description: Accessible name for the header toggle while expanded.

props.name: expandLabel
props.description: Accessible name for the expand affordance while collapsed.

props.name: profile
props.description: The signed-in person, rendered as the footer's Avatar row.

props.name: footerSlot
props.description: Rendered in the footer above the profile row — a theme toggle, a storage meter. Fades out while collapsed, AppSidebar's contract.

props.name: collapsedFooterSlot
props.description: Rendered above the profile row while the panel is collapsed, in `footerSlot`'s place: the same controls at their smallest, such as a SegmentedControl's or ThemeToggle's `cycle` circle, stacked and centred on the rail's axis. AppSidebar's contract: the two forms share one cell and crossfade with the panel, and whichever is hidden is inert.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional CSS classes

props.name: linkComponent
props.description:
The component its links render with, such as Next.js's `Link`, so they
navigate through the app's router; a plain `<a>` when unset. This
component can render on the server, so it never reads a LinkProvider:
pass the prop even under one.

LinkComponent.description: A component that renders a link in place of a plain `<a>`, such as a router's.

LinkComponentProps.description:
The props a link component receives: every anchor attribute, the ref, and
an `href` that is always a string. Next.js's `Link` takes these as they
are; a router whose link takes `to` instead needs a one-line adapter:
`({ href, ...props }) => <RouterLink to={href} {...props} />`.

Shortcut.description: A shortcut in the grammar above, such as `mod+k`, `shift+?` or `g i`.

ShortcutKeyLabels.description: The legends a shortcut is drawn with, by modifier or key name. Merged over the platform's defaults.

ThreadPanelThreadStatus.description:
What a thread's leading dot reports. Fill says whether the thread wants
the reader, colour says what it wants, motion says it is live right now:
`idle` is a hollow neutral ring, `working` a pulsing neutral dot, and
`unread`, `waiting` and `error` solid dots in the info, warning and error
roles.
